title: Why APPLE Makes Only 60 Words? Explained Simply | Class 11 Maths
description:
Five different letters can be shuffled into 120 words. The five letters of APPLE make only 60. Where did half of the words go? The answer is the two P's: swap them and the word looks exactly the same. This animated lesson follows NCERT Chapter 6, Permutations and Combinations (Class 11).

You will watch a live paint test: two P's painted different colours give 6 arrangements of A, P, P, then the paint washes off and each pair melts into one word, leaving 3. From there we build the rule n! / p! and the general form n! / (p1! p2! ... pk!), and watch the count shrink live as more letters become the same. Two pause-and-think questions, a worked example with BANANA, the exam trap of adding the repeats, an original JEE Main pattern question on SUCCESS, a recap card and three questions to check yourself.

Follows the NCERT book. Useful for CBSE, ICSE (ISC), Karnataka PUC and other state boards, and JEE.
